answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network maps each agent as a graph vertex governed by an epochal pulse where identities must execute cryptographic stake burning. Operating costs scale superlinearly: minting $N$ collateralized identities requires burning raw asset tokens—priced like an escalating commodity such as copper—at $O(N^2)$ quadratic cost. This mathematical friction makes spawning fake agents exponentially prohibitive while legitimate agents retain equilibrium.
